The '''Rubogea system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] tactic known as the [[Rubogean Gambit]].<ref name="DN3">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Rubogean Gambit]]|system=Rubogea [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Rubogea [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" />
